headline: 8 of 8 in 37 minutes on a quiet Thursday, with almost no world buffs

mvp.headline: 99 dispels in a 37-minute ZG
why: 99 dispels, three times the next healer (Palastino 32)
Dispelled Venoxis' Holy Fire and the Hex on Jin'do

also.text: average parse 75, 91 on Mar'li and 89 on Arlokk, 4 interrupts
32 dispels, 3 Blessings of Protection and a Lay on Hands

overview: A 20-raider ZG with only a handful of the usual guild names, cleared in 36:58 against the guild's usual 46:37. No wipes and three boss deaths.
Almost nobody came buffed: 4 of 20 had Rallying Cry at Jeklik and nobody had Zandalar or Songflower, so raid DPS sat a little under the guild's usual on most bosses.

wentWell.text: Mar'li in 0:50 against a median of 0:58, Poison Bolt Volley hitting 4.5 times per raider against a usual 6.3. Fluffycatto 91.
Venoxis in 0:48 with the Holy Wrath chain hitting 7 raiders, under the usual rate.
Hakkar in 2:14, right on the median, with nobody dying through 57 Corrupted Blood applications.
